register_all_coco: register all predefined COCO dataset splits including instances and keypoints to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_lvis: register all predefined LVIS dataset splits for instance detection to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_cityscapes: register all predefined Cityscapes dataset splits for instance and semantic segmentation
register_all_pascal_voc: register all predefined PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 dataset splits to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_ade20k: register all predefined ADE20K dataset splits for semantic segmentation to the DatasetCatalog
